text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey felt the deep passion that 
the dirt track elites brought to their 
races. However, far from being 
intimidated—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She has etched her existence into the 
minds of her two rivals. At the Champions 
Cup, a true, no-holds-barred battle 
finally begins.
